results.name: Eight real call links have unique approved placements and the correct number
Fresh and declined choices send nothing and never load Google
Acceptance loads one tag and one clean page view, with advertising consent denied and automatic GA page views off
One activation gives one event for every actual placement through one bubbling listener
Unknown placements and other telephone numbers cannot enter the payload
Collector failure never prevents or throws through dialing
GPC overrides saved acceptance and never starts Google
Preview, apex and unrelated paths cannot load analytics
Storage unavailable, expired and future-dated consent all fail closed
Withdrawal stops events and clears only helpline cookies; renewed choice does not duplicate the tag
Exactly the two fixed ChatGPT campaign tuples accompany existing consented events
Unknown, partial, duplicated and injected campaign tuples never enter analytics
Other URL fields, advertising click identifiers and private fragments are not forwarded even on a valid tuple
Tagged traffic without new consent, with old acceptance, refusal or GPC sends nothing
Repeated and renewed consent does not duplicate attributed page views, and dialing remains untouched
New disclosure describes limited fixed campaign labels and preserves refusal-safe calling

scope: First-party code tests. Actual third-party request/ingestion is checked separately in the browser. Phone-link events do not establish connected calls.
